subject: URGENT: Client Acme Corp - Critical Feature Request Before Contract Renewal
body:
Hi,

I'm reaching out as our contract renewal is coming up on July 31st ($2.4M ARR) and we have a critical blocker.

Our enterprise customers are demanding real-time data sync which your platform currently doesn't support. This is a hard requirement for us to renew. We've seen competitors offering this and our clients are pushing us to switch.

Specifically, we need:
1. Real-time webhook notifications (< 500ms latency)
2. Bi-directional data sync with our CRM (Salesforce)
3. Custom field mapping

Can we get a commitment by this Friday (July 2) on whether this can be delivered within 90 days? If not, we'll need to begin evaluating alternatives.

I value our 3-year partnership and want to make this work.

David Walsh
CTO, Acme Corp
snippet: Contract renewal coming up July 31 ($2.4M ARR). Need real-time webhook notifications as hard requirement...

analysis.summary: Acme Corp CTO threatening to not renew $2.4M ARR contract unless real-time data sync is committed by July 2. Needs webhooks (<500ms), Salesforce bi-directional sync, and custom field mapping within 90 days.
action_items: Escalate to CTO and sales leadership immediately
Assess feasibility of real-time webhooks and Salesforce sync
Respond to David Walsh with commitment/timeline by July 2

subject: Technical Issue: Payment API Integration Returning 500 Errors - 23% Failure Rate
body:
Automated Alert: Payment API health check failed.

Details:
- Service: payment-api-v2
- Error Rate: 23% (threshold: 5%)
- Error Type: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
- Affected Endpoint: POST /api/v2/payments/process
- Duration: 47 minutes (since 05:13 UTC)
- Impact: ~340 failed payment attempts
- Revenue Impact: Estimated $42,000 in blocked transactions

Error Stack Trace (sample):
DatabaseConnectionError: Connection pool exhausted
at PaymentProcessor.execute (payment.service.ts:247)
at DatabasePool.getConnection (db.pool.ts:89)

Suggested Actions:
1. Restart payment-api-v2 pods
2. Check database connection pool settings
3. Review recent deployments (last deploy: 04:30 UTC)

Dashboard: https://monitoring.internal/payment-api
snippet: Payment API error rate at 23% (threshold 5%). 340 failed payments, $42K revenue impact since 05:13 UTC...

analysis.summary: Payment API is failing at 23% error rate due to database connection pool exhaustion. 340 failed payments totaling ~$42K since 05:13 UTC. Likely caused by deployment at 04:30 UTC.
action_items: Investigate deployment at 04:30 UTC for breaking changes
